allOf.description: An file lives underneath a piece of content and represents a single file or body of content.

id.description: The unique Zywave identifier for the file.

FileInfo.description: File represents the editable properties of a file.

contentId.description: The content identifier to add the file under.  Passing in null will create a new piece of content alongside the file

fileId.description: The unique file id that is associated to a file stored in the system. Generate a new guid if creating a new file.

language.description:
The language code for the file. Defaults to US English "en-us". 
There is no restrictions, but it is recommended that the value be set to the ISO 639-1 Language Code (https://www.andiamo.co.uk/resources/iso-language-codes/).
